data.title: Electricity price increase – Beispielstrom Mittelhessen
data.summary: Beispielstrom Mittelhessen GmbH is raising the prices in Bastian Musterquell's "Region Basis" electricity tariff from 1 January 2027, citing higher grid and procurement costs. The monthly advance payment (Abschlag) rises from €86.00 to €92.00.
data.explanation: Your electricity supplier is increasing its unit prices and your monthly advance payment (Abschlag) starting 1 January 2027. German law gives you a special right to terminate the contract without notice and without any cost if you don't agree with the new prices, as long as your cancellation reaches the supplier before the price change takes effect. The app will show you until when you can exercise this right. If you do nothing, the new prices and the higher advance payment simply apply from the effective date.
